mentions.description: A reverse engineering project of an old game (weltendaemmerung), part of a series of reverse engineering efforts on old games, with the goal of finding a pattern by which an AI can recover at least 99% of the game's disassembly.
mentions.problem: Manual reverse engineering of old games' disassembly lacks an automated approach; the goal is for an AI pattern to achieve at least 99% disassembly coverage.
